about: Russell Township is a rural municipality in the United Counties of Prescott and Russell, Ontario, east of Ottawa toward Embrun, Russell village, and Marionville. Francophone and bilingual villages sit among farmland on Ottawa’s eastern fringe rather than forming a continuous city. Highways and county roads link into the capital region. About 19,000 people live in Russell Township.
seoSummary: Prescott–Russell township of Embrun and Russell village—bilingual farmland east of Ottawa, not a city.
